title: Korean Legacy Site Relaunch Desk
oneLiner: Small Korean agencies turn old Gnuboard-style sites into a calm React/CMS migration quote, checklist, and owner demo path.
targetUser: Korean small web agencies, freelancers, and business owners maintaining old community boards, local business sites, or membership portals.
keyUx: Scan the old site type, map board/member/payment/content risks, choose a migration tier, and export a quote plus owner-facing relaunch demo checklist.
stitchPrompt: Create a polished agency workbench called “Korean Legacy Site Relaunch Desk” for Korean web agencies migrating old Gnuboard-style sites to modern Laravel/React CMS workflows. Include legacy site intake, board/member/content risk map, migration tier selector, owner demo storyboard, cost and timeline estimate, SEO redirect checklist, and relaunch quote packet. Design direction: use the premium-editorial profile with refined Korean agency presentation, warm off-white surfaces, elegant content blocks, restrained accent color, and client-ready quote polish.
